labelSplit.rule: HL3-HL5 majority mode is never read by the selection function

allocation: Equal numbers of development-frontier and development-interior control coordinates; the 24-coordinate set must be nested inside the 32-coordinate set.
continuousModel: Y_i,p,c,r = mu_i + A_i,p + beta_c + (A beta)_i,p,c + epsilon_i,p,c,r, where coordinate effects are fixed for the deliberately selected pilot, preparation and preparation-by-condition terms are pooled random components, and beta is the prespecified two-condition contrast.
primaryContinuousAdjudicands: aligned full-profile distance to an external reference pattern
binaryEndpointRole: Phase-adjudication discordance is descriptive in the micro-pilot and confirmatory only after enough independent control coordinates are acquired.

controlGate.method: one-sided exact binomial upper bound when zero control failures are observed

stop: preparation identifiers or raw-frame parentage are missing
the two nominal preparations are not independent
external reference calibration fails before phase analysis
the preregistered reduction cannot be run without outcome-dependent choices
redesign: preparation variance cannot be separated from coordinate or residual variation
condition effects reverse across preparations without a modeled interaction
continuous control variation overlaps the prespecified minimum phase-change signal
branchRules.expand: Expand only after the nested model is identifiable, raw-to-result lineage is complete, and a blinded second reduction reproduces the continuous variance ordering.
